fullDescription: A high-impact, dark-mode design system characterized by bold editorial typography, vibrant orange-red accents, and intricate micro-interactions. Featuring a 'noise' texture overlay and a geometric grid-based layout, this style is ideal for creative developers, design agencies, or fintech landing pages. It uses a sophisticated color palette of deep blacks, slate surfaces, and warm tan highlights, paired with high-performance animations like floating SVG shapes, pulsing glows, and smooth scroll-triggered transitions.
prompt:
## Resumo
A bold, dark-themed portfolio or creative landing page design featuring vibrant red-orange accents, sophisticated typography, and complex interactive animations. The aesthetic combines professional structure with artistic flair through the use of grain overlays, grid patterns, and floating geometric elements.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system with the following specs: COLORS: Background #0C0C0C, Surface #141414, Light Surface #1C1C1C, Accent Red #E8553A, Warm Highlight #D4A574, Text Primary #F0EDE8, Text Secondary #B0ADA8, Muted #8A8A8A. TYPOGRAPHY: Headlines in 'Clash Grotesk' (Bold, 400-700), Body in 'Satoshi' (400-700). Heading sizes range from 48px to 72px with tight line-height (1.05). EFFECTS: Apply a 3% opacity noise overlay across the entire site. Use a 40px dot grid pattern (#333 1px dots) for section backgrounds. Interactive elements should use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for all transitions. ANIMATIONS: Floating keyframes (transform: translate/rotate), pulse glow effects for background orbs, and seamless horizontal marquees for technical tags.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
Sticky header with 64px height. Background #0C0C0C with a subtle 5% white border-bottom. Left-side logo: a 32px rounded-lg #E8553A box with a single initial, rotating 12deg on hover. Right-side: text links in #B0ADA8 (size 14px) with an orange underline appearing on hover. Include a pill-shaped 'Hire Me' button with #E8553A background.

### Hero Section
Two-column layout. Left side: 'Available for Hire' badge with a 48px horizontal orange line. Headline using 'Clash Grotesk' at 72px with multi-color gradients (Accent to Warm). Subtext at 18px leading-relaxed. CTA buttons: one solid #E8553A pill-shaped, one bordered #FFFFFF15. Right side: A complex interactive orb composed of rotating concentric rings (5% white and 10% accent) with floating technology icons orbiting a central avatar placeholder.

### Skill Marquee
Full-width section with 5% white borders top and bottom. Background #141414. A seamless horizontal scrolling list of skills. Each item features a 6px colored dot (alternating between #E8553A and #D4A574) and 14px medium-weight text. Animation speed: 25s for a full loop.

### Projects Bento Grid
3-column grid layout where featured projects span 2 columns. Cards have 16px border-radius and #141414 background. Each card has a hover effect: translateY(-6px) and an overlay showing 'Live Demo' buttons. Tech tags at the bottom of cards are pill-shaped with #1C1C1C background and transition to #E8553A on card hover.

### Experience Timeline
Vertical layout with a 1px border-left (#FFFFFF10) serving as the timeline path. Each entry has a 14px circular dot (#E8553A) that scales up and glows on hover. Content includes 18px font-display headings and 14px secondary text descriptions.

### Contact Section
Centered layout. Headline at 60px using 'Clash Grotesk'. Three grid cards below: icon top-center, title, and detail text. Social links footer: 48px square containers with 12px border-radius, background #141414, 10% white border. Icons scale and turn #E8553A on hover.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Interactive Visual Orb — A complex hero visual element representing a core identity or tech stack.
Create a 384px container. Center a circular gradient avatar. Surround it with two border rings (1px #FFFFFF05 and 1px #E8553A10). Apply a 'spin-slow' animation (20s-30s) to the rings in opposite directions. Place 48px square icon containers at 0, 90, 180, and 270 degrees. Apply unique floating animations (float1 through float4) to each icon container so they drift independently while orbiting.

### Skill Tag Hover State — A micro-interaction for metadata tags.
Pill-shaped tag with 12px horizontal and 6px vertical padding. Background #1C1C1C, text #B0ADA8. On hover, background shifts instantly to #E8553A and text shifts to #0C0C0C. Apply a transition timing of 0.3s ease.

## Notas Especiais
MUST: Maintain the noise overlay for texture. Use 'Clash Grotesk' exclusively for large headings (32px+). Ensure all cards have the specific cubic-bezier transition. Use 5% white borders for a sophisticated 'ghost' container look. MUST NOT: Use standard blue for links. Avoid heavy shadows; use thin borders and translation transforms instead. Do not use vibrant colors for body text; keep it strictly #F0EDE8 or #B0ADA8.

Animations are defined by smooth 'Framer Motion' style transitions (cubic-bezier) and continuous floating background movements.
